steps.name: censusBoot
steps.expr: (()=>{const f=window.__hbFetch;if(!f)return '<absent>';const lanes={};let bytes=0;for(const k in f.lanes){lanes[k]={done:f.lanes[k].done,bytes:f.lanes[k].bytes};bytes+=f.lanes[k].bytes;}const comp={};for(const k in f.byComponent){const c=f.byComponent[k];if(c.requests)comp[k]={requests:c.requests,mb:+(c.bytes/1048576).toFixed(2)};}return {totalMB:+(bytes/1048576).toFixed(2),forgotten:f.forgotten,retries:f.retries,lanes,comp};})()
